description: This file defines a simple Spring Boot REST controller for demo authentication endpoints, including user info retrieval via request headers and a basic login endpoint that echoes the username. It serves as an illustrative placeholder for authentication mechanisms.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: A REST controller providing demo authentication endpoints, including user info and login simulation.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Retrieves current user info based on 'X-User-Id' header for demo purposes.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Simulates user login by echoing back the provided username, instructing the client to send it via header.
